title: EnvironmentCreateRequest
description: Request to create a new environment.

clusterName.description: Cluster name where the environment will be deployed

storagePlanName.description: Name of the storage plan for the environment

databasePlanName.description: Name of the database plan for the environment

deploymentPackageName.description: Name of the package for the deployment

isExternalSecretStoreEnabled.description: Indicate if External Secret Store is enabled for environment configuration, applicable only for Standalone mode cluster.

coreResourcePlan.description: Core Resource Plan for environment creation, it's only for connected mode.

coreResourceSize.description: Core Resource Size for environment, not support Custom Size for environment creation. If need, please use PATCH API to config Custom Size after environment created.
